name: player_rebuild_steer_basis_raw_from_ref
description: Player::RebuildSteerBasisRawFromRef rebuilds and normalizes steerBasisRaw from steerBasisNorm projected onto the steerBasisRef plane when the reference Y component is nonzero.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent Player hover/master-type orientation pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x42b8c0 validates the saveState->playerState contract, the steerBasisRef.y == 0 guard, the rawBasis.y plane solve from steerBasisRef.x/z and steerBasisNorm.x/z, the zMath::Vec3Normalize call, and storage to steerBasisRaw.
The native smoke verifies the projected normalized basis and that zero reference Y leaves steerBasisRaw unchanged.
